notes.note: Change limited to the reader hold: input-less, movement-less scroll events no longer mark a holding reader scrolled up, and only a new user message (matched across client id, turn.started event and server id; not a bubble shown while a turn runs; not earlier history) ends the hold. Citing pages: chat-composer.md hold paragraph updated in the same change; ai-ui-bridge-expansion.md cites the form-submission context, unaffected; placement.md claims unaffected.
